question: Of the four substances mentioned in the following options, which one has the highest electrical resistivity at 20°C, as compared to the other three?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manganese.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Electrical resistivity** is represented by the **Greek letter ρ (rho).**
 
• It is a** measure of the resistance of a specific material** of a** given size, to the electrical current conduction **that flows through it.
 
• The **SI unit **is expressed in** ohm-metres (Ωm).**
 
• **Insulators** have high values of electrical resistivity in the range of** 1010 Ωm or more.**
